metadata.description: Curated Claude Code plugins that ship quality. sniff (AI-powered QA, 427 tests), ui-ux-suite (design audit across 12 dimensions, 24 UX laws), recap-studio (one-page explainers, 7-dimension validation), aws-cost-audit (evidence-first AWS cost auditor that verifies prices live and never deletes without proof). Zero bloat. The tool plugins are dual-mode (install as a Claude Code plugin or as a standalone MCP server); aws-cost-audit is a Claude Code skill that reads your AWS account locally.

plugins.name: sniff
plugins.description: AI-powered QA testing. Scan source code, check accessibility, visual regression, performance, and run autonomous E2E discovery. Auto-detects your dev server.

plugins.name: ui-ux-suite
plugins.description: Design audit tool. Scores projects across 12 dimensions (color, typography, a11y, layout) grounded in 24 named UX laws with primary-source citations. WCAG, APCA, OKLCH color science. Zero dependencies.

plugins.name: recap-studio
plugins.description: Generate beautiful, mobile-first one-page explainers in under 5 minutes. 13 specialist agents pass typed JSON through a 7-dimension validation board; offline-safe demo for any topic or coding session. Static-first Next.js output.

plugins.name: aws-cost-audit
plugins.description: Evidence-first AWS cost audit. Reads your live AWS account read-only, attributes every dollar, finds idle/orphaned/over-provisioned resources, verifies prices live (never hardcoded), and ships a safe, reversible, gated savings plan with confidence levels. A Claude Code skill (no MCP server).
